name: savings-receipt
title: Savings receipt
description: What you would pay for the tools this replaces, added up like a receipt against your single price and the saving it makes.
docs: Pass items (a generic label and a price each), ours (your name and price), action, asOf and, for the right figures, period (month or year), currency and locale. Prices are in whole currency units for one period. The receipt is a real table: a row per tool with a dotted leader to its price in tabular figures, a total row with the sum struck through, then your price in large type. The saving line is computed from the numbers, in whole cents so the sums are exact: it is always said for a year, the percent is rounded down so the claim is never larger than the sum, and when your price is not lower the receipt says there is no saving instead of claiming one. asOf is required: it is printed under the button as Prices checked 1 October 2026, in a time element, because price comparisons age fast. note says how the comparison was made. Use generic names for the tools, never a competitor's. labels translates every fixed word, including the saving sentence.
